snippet.title: PSX Longplay [091] Rockman Complete Works: Rockman
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played By: Tsunao

The first game that started one of Capcom's known franchise, but you [should] already know that.  This is more of a port released in Japan as part of a series called "Rockman Complete Works".

Follow Me--Rockman as he commits robot-on-robot violence to get to an evil scientist.  Since this is in Japanese and there's no intro:  THERE'S NO PLOT!  Game is known for its bastard difficulty!

For this run, I play on Navi Mode, which switches up a few things (quick weapon selection with L and R buttons, Mega Man 8-ish bars, Beat as a guide, and someone acting as Navigator.  Dr. Light acts as Navigator in this one).  I also spam rapid fire (Friangle button) like a noob because some enemies have TOO much HP. -_-  Boss weakness is also abused...like a noob. -_-  This game felt kinda messy.  Then again, it IS a NES game.

No friggin' skills involved!

Oh, and it needs a "Bumo!" =( -
